item.title: Update: Cassidy Nickerson, wanted on a province-wide warrant, arrested
item.description: SHELBURNE: Police say that Cassidy Nickerson, wanted on a province-wide warrant, has been arrested. The 29-year-old Shelburne County woman is charged with eight counts of Breach of Probation. The RCMP thanks members of the public for their support in locating Nickerson. File #: 2025-1820475
